system.description:
You perform a high kick combo. Make two Taijutsu attacks, dealing your [Unarmed damage] + 1d6.

Finisher: You instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 3d6, leap back 15 feet that doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks and the target must make a constitution saving throw, being Shaken on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and each instance of damage by 1d6 and if cast as a Finisher, the leap back range by 10 feet.
